notes: Parity subset: 25 of 261 tasks (uv run securereviewer --split parity), stratified by security type with seed 42. Both sides send the same prompt (upstream's review prompt + the raw diff + the output-format section of the Harbor instruction) in one Messages API call with the same settings (temperature 0 as upstream's greedy decoding, max_tokens 2000), via the 2077ai endpoint. Original side: infer/test_api.py in the fork, parsed with upstream parse_security_review and scored with upstream evaluate/SecureBleu.py (unmodified). Harbor side: the single-call agent in parity/, run on Daytona with the separate verifier. Metric: SecureBLEU (0-100), the mean over items; Harbor value = mean reward x 100. Run-to-run differences come from API nondeterminism at temperature 0. Harbor 0.26.0 (Daytona SDK 0.233.0). Model ID is the alias claude-haiku-4-5 on both sides, because the endpoint rejects the dated ID claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Run order: a one-task sanity check per side, then original runs 1-2, then Harbor runs 1-2.
